provenance.name: SAD
provenance.description: Stress in real-world driving (drivedb), whole recordings.
provenance.origin: Frozen reference profile estimated in the author's PhD work and ported to DERMA.
provenance.citation: Healey JA, Picard RW. Detecting stress during real-world driving tasks using physiological sensors. IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems 6(2), 156-166 (2005). doi:10.1109/TITS.2005.848368. Distributed by PhysioNet (drivedb): Goldberger AL et al., Circulation 101(23), e215-e220 (2000).
provenance.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0

estimation.decomposition: cvxEDA (Greco et al., 2016), tau0 = 2.0 s, tau1 = 0.7 s
estimation.cvxeda_hyperparameters: alpha, gamma and delta_knot were tuned manually for each recording by expert visual inspection, independently of any automatic hyperparameter optimization; the per-recording values were not preserved.
estimation.segmentation: contiguous blocks of the target conditions, segments shorter than 60 s discarded, longer segments split into chunks of at most 300 s
estimation.distribution_selection: maximum likelihood fit, family with minimum AIC
